openai-codex/gpt-6-sol.character: Advisory: GPT-6 Sol runs at high for the advisor session and child advisors, including planning and synthesis. The same model is the regular workhorse at xhigh for bounded implementation, fully locked execution packets, and fresh-context checking. Own investigation, local planning, implementation or repair, and verification within the assignment. For locked packets, resolve environment and tooling obstacles locally, use deterministic anchors, and escalate material ambiguity outside the assignment. Use max for materially ambiguous or wide-breadth implementation. This profile recommends Codex models only.

openai-codex/gpt-6-luna.character: Advisory: An economical option at max reasoning for explicit browser-flow checks by the assigned builder or checker. Browser verification is an author responsibility, not a separate role or required stage.

builder.fit: Preferred workhorse for regular bounded implementation, including fully locked execution packets with deterministic anchors and stop-on-material-ambiguity.
Reserve for materially ambiguous or wide-breadth implementation.

advisor.fit: Preferred for bounded end-to-end work with delegated internal steps in this profile.

checker.fit: Preferred fresh-context checker and reviewer in this profile.
